topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: L-DACS integration enhances spectrum sharing by enabling precise time-division duplexing, minimizing overlap with terrestrial frequencies. This requires sophisticated antenna design for accurate array factor tuning to mitigate interference. However, this increased precision demands advanced network coordination strategies to minimize latency and maximize bandwidth efficiency.  This is further complicated by the need for dynamic spectrum allocation to adapt to real-time traffic demands in congested airspace.
reference_context: L-DACS integration offers precise time-division duplexing (TDM) for efficient spectrum sharing, minimizing interference between terrestrial and satellite links. However, this precision demands advanced antenna design for accurate array factor tuning and sophisticated network coordination strategies to mitigate latency and maximize bandwidth efficiency in congested airspace.
